rules.statement: An ultra vires administrative act can be challenged in two ways, including collateral challenge, but the question of collateral challenge does not arise in the circumstances of this case.
rules.supporting_quote: Our attention was further invited to Administrative Law: Text and Materials [Beatson, Matthews and Elliot (eds.), 3rd ed., Oxford University Press, 2005, page 109] and Judicial Remedies in Public Law [Clive Lewis, 5 th ed. (Sweet and Maxwell South Asian Edition, 2017), page 187, paragraph 5-011] where the opportunity to impugn an invalid administrative act in collateral proceedings is indorsed.
